ASJJF 2027 — GI

【 ASJJF-Sanctioned Championship — 4 Stars Certification 】

This is an official championship organized by A.G.I. Asian Sport Jiu-Jitsu Federation (ASJJF) and awards ranking points according to its star certification.

Our aim is to provide a fair, organized and reliable environment for all athletes who practice Jiu-Jitsu as a competitive sport.

Please read all information carefully before registering.

【 Key information 】

Championship date

February 20, 2027.

Venue

Komazawa Okunai Kyugijo (indoor Ball Court)

Komazawa Koen 1-1
Setagaya Tokyo
Japan

Gi

Certification

4 STARS

Spectator admission

FREE

(01) 【 Spectator admission 】

General spectator admission is free at this championship. No admission fee will be charged.

Athletes and companions

Registered athletes may enter free. Athletes competing in KIDS 1 through KIDS 6 may enter with one companion, who must enter together with the athlete.

Black belts

Black belt athletes and coaches with a valid Member ID Card may access exclusive areas, where provided.

※ General free admission does not depend on a Member ID Card. A valid card is required for black belt-specific benefits.

↥ Back to top

(02) 【 Registration and My Page 】

All registrations and changes must be made through My Page within the championship deadlines.

▶︎ How to register for an event and use My Page

※ Instructions are available only in Japanese.

Before registering

Register only after confirming that you can attend on the event date. If your schedule could still change due to travel, another event, exams, or personal, family or work commitments, wait until your attendance is certain.

This helps avoid last-minute cancellations, disruption to other athletes and changes to the brackets.

※ Changes to personal plans do not qualify for cancellation or refund under the event policy.

↥ Back to top

(03) 【 Member ID Card 】

The Member ID Card is the athlete’s official identification in the federation system. It makes identification, check-in, weigh-in and official T-shirt collection (when offered) easier.

To obtain the card, the athlete must submit a complete and accurate profile, which will be reviewed by the federation.

Issuance requirements

1. Photograph

  • Face clearly visible.
  • Good image quality.
  • No accessories that obstruct identification.

※ Example photograph:

2. Official photo ID

  • Passport, driver’s license or equivalent official document.
  • The document must identify the athlete; full name and date of birth are recommended.

3. Belt history

White belts: starting date in Jiu-Jitsu and name of the responsible instructor.

Colored belts: date of each promotion and the promoting instructor, from the first belt to the current belt.

Black belts with degrees: all previous belt records plus the date and responsible instructor for each degree.

※ Only profiles that meet these requirements are eligible for card issuance.

Benefits

  • Faster identification at events.
  • Smoother check-in and official weigh-in.
  • Easier collection of official T-shirts, if offered.
  • Integrated athlete records in the federation system.
  • For black belts with a valid card: free admission to paid events and access to exclusive areas where provided.

Regularization deadline

The Member ID Card must be regularized no later than 5 days before the first day of the championship.

Deadline for this event:: February 15, 2027.

※ Cards will not be issued on competition day. Issuance, renewal or correction before the event cannot be guaranteed after the deadline.

Screenshot

Athletes and coaches are strongly advised to save a screenshot of their Member ID Card on a mobile device in case the internet connection is unstable.

↥ Back to top

(04) 【 Payment and confirmation 】

Official payment method

PayPal, including credit cards processed through PayPal, is the official payment method. Bank transfer should be used only when PayPal is not possible.

International bank transfers

The intermediary bank and the receiving bank in Japan charge ¥3,000 each, totaling ¥6,000 in charges in Japan. Add this amount to the registration fee and cover all applicable bank charges.

※ Registration will not be confirmed if the amount received is insufficient.

Confirmation of domestic or international transfers

Check that your name appears on the Athlete List. If it does not appear within 3 days of payment, contact the federation immediately and send the transfer receipt.

Athletes must enter their Registration Number correctly when transferring funds. The federation is not responsible for delays or inability to identify a payment caused by missing, incorrect or inconsistent information, or unidentified transfers.

※ Funds deposited without identification and without contact from the sender for more than 30 days may be designated as a donation, with no refund, credit or future compensation.

(06) 【 Checking and correcting registration data 】

Athletes

Review the Athlete List and check your name, date of birth, belt, weight, age division and team. Make corrections through My Page within the deadline; contact official support if you cannot complete the changes yourself.

Coaches

Corrections for team members and strategic division adjustments affecting team ranking must be requested in a single email from the address registered with the federation, stating the existing and correct information.

On verification day, athletes and coaches must recheck the Athlete List to confirm that corrections were made.

※ No new correction requests will be accepted after the deadline.

↥ Back to top

(07) 【 Match schedule and athlete calls 】

COMING SOON

Timing instructions

※ Failure to report when called may result in disqualification for non-appearance (walkover/WO).

Headphones and earbuds

Avoid wearing headphones or earbuds while waiting for a match: they may prevent you from hearing your name.

Wearing headphones does not remove the athlete’s responsibility to listen for calls and report on time. Failure to appear may result in a walkover, even if the athlete missed the call because of headphones.

Reports of delay or absence

Only the responsible coach or a member of the same academy may report a delay or absence. The organization may record the reporter’s name for internal control.

↥ Back to top

(08) 【 Eligibility and competition requirements 】

White belt eligibility restrictions

The following athletes may not compete as white belts (beginners):

※ Eligibility may be verified through official domestic or international competition records, including event websites and related pages.

Kids who hold gray, yellow, orange or green belts may not enter a white belt division in Juvenile or Adult categories.

New rules — Effective January 1, 2027

1. Jumping guard is prohibited

White belt athletes may not jump into guard during their matches.

2. Ten-title limit at white belt

After earning valid champion titles at 10 separate championships, an athlete may no longer compete at white belt starting with the championship following the tenth counted title.

A maximum of ONE title is counted per championship, regardless of the number of gold medals earned.

※ Example: four gold medals across Gi, No-Gi, weight and absolute divisions at one championship count as one title, provided at least one title was earned through an actual match.

※ Individual ranking points are separate from this rule: a champion without an opponent receives the applicable ranking points but does not add a title toward the white belt limit.

Affiliation

All athletes must be formally affiliated with a black belt instructor. The federation may verify affiliation and refuse participation when it cannot be confirmed.

Athletes must carry official photo identification on event day; they may be asked to present it before a match.

Keep registration details accurate and the Member ID Card regularized by the stated deadline.

(13) 【 Athletes without an opponent 】

Official request period

00:00–23:59 on  February 15, 2027.

An athlete is officially considered to have no opponent only when alone in the division during this period. Before then, another athlete may register or be transferred into the division; early requests will not be accepted.

Available options

▶︎ Dedicated form — Division change without an opponent

※ Requests may also be submitted through official support.

↥ Back to top

(14) 【 Cancellation and refund policy 】

Only athletes who remain without an opponent in their division during the official 24-hour period are eligible to request a refund. Requests must be submitted within that period through the dedicated form or official support.

▶︎ Dedicated form — Cancellation and refund

Important conditions

1. Before the official period

Even if an athlete is alone before the designated date, another competitor may register or be transferred. Eligibility is determined only on the official date.

2. No request submitted

If no request is made within the deadline, the athlete will automatically be considered champion without an opponent and will not be entitled to a refund.

3. Bad-faith changes

Intentional last-minute changes made to obtain an uncontested division do not justify a refund. The case may be referred for disciplinary review, with possible warning, suspension or an indefinite ban from events organized or sanctioned by ASJJF, SJJIF and their affiliates.

4. Personal reasons

Changes in personal plans do not qualify under the cancellation policy.

Weight division and absolute division

Registration in the weight division is mandatory; the absolute division requires an additional fee. If an athlete enters both and only one has no opponent, only the uncontested division may be cancelled, and the refund is limited to the additional absolute-division fee regardless of which division is uncontested.

※ The base weight-division registration fee is non-refundable.

Examples: when there is a match at weight but none at absolute, only the absolute fee is refunded; when there is a match at absolute but none at weight, the refund is still limited to that additional fee.

Transfers

Registration and fees may not be transferred to another athlete or event.

↥ Back to top

 

(16) 【 Award ceremony rules 】

Athletes must attend the award ceremony wearing the same type of uniform used in their matches.

Uniform: GI — COMPLETE GI.

Displaying belts, flags or similar items during the official photo session is prohibited.

Medals will be awarded only during the ceremony on event day. Shipping or later collection is not available.

↥ Back to top

  • Matches may begin up to 30 minutes earlier than their scheduled time.
  • Athletes must be at the warm-up area at least 40 minutes before their scheduled time and must listen for calls.
  • Athletes must report within 5 minutes after being called.
  • If the event runs ahead of schedule, callers will follow the organization’s internal calling procedure.
  • Judo black belts.
  • Athletes with professional MMA experience.
  • Athletes with official amateur MMA bout records.
  • Athletes who have competed in wrestling, including Olympic freestyle, Greco-Roman or equivalent styles.
  • Gi and No-Gi gold medals at the same championship count as one title.
  • Weight division and absolute division gold medals at the same championship also count as one title.
  • Gold medals awarded without an opponent (alone in the bracket) do not count toward the limit.
  • Male athletes compete only in male divisions.
  • Female athletes compete only in female divisions.
  • Win by submission: +3
  • Win by points or any other non-submission result: +1
  1. Remain in the division, receive the champion medal and applicable individual ranking points.
  2. Request a division change.
  3. Request cancellation and refund under the stated conditions.
  • Pets are not permitted, except guide/assistance animals.
  • Smoking is allowed only in designated areas.
  • Alcoholic beverages may not be consumed anywhere inside the venue.
  • Official weight is measured in kilograms (kg).
  • False registration information, including date of birth, belt or team, will result in immediate disqualification and may affect eligibility for future competitions.
  • An official photo ID must be carried on event day and may be requested before a match.
  • All athletes must be formally affiliated with a black belt instructor; the federation may verify affiliation.
  • Plan airfare and accommodation after completing registration, taking account of the event deadlines and conditions.
  • support@asjjf.org
  • edisonbjj@gmail.com
